scope: Partial, executable synthetic verification mapped to the 79 full future acceptance specifications; this file does not grant full acceptance

entries.verified_subset: Simply supported uniform stiff string, analytic eigenfrequency and five grid resolutions, low modes 1 and 3
entries.remaining_gap: Other endpoint/boundary conditions, manufactured forced field, tensor components, independent operator implementation, moving boundary and production geometry

entries.verified_subset: Scalar nodal power port, linear interpolation, fixed-end zero-velocity check and exact midpoint work ledger
entries.remaining_gap: Randomized vector property suite, rotated frames, multi-axis weighted adjoints, nonuniform quadrature and non-coincident interfaces

entries.verified_subset: Linear SPD grid under three rates and high-mode phase; explicit CFL rejection separately executable
entries.remaining_gap: Proof/negative tests for nonlinear contact, variable coefficients, mixed boundary and failed solve policies

entries.verified_subset: Lossless fixed-support midpoint grid, driven point force, per-step and accumulated work residual
entries.remaining_gap: Damping, moving supports, separate longitudinal/polarization energies, nail/fret and full radiating body

entries.verified_subset: Uniform-grid stiff-string modal dispersion, zero-EI limit, first five modes and analytic temporal warping
entries.remaining_gap: Nonuniform and measured strings, loss/dispersion separability, alias-control and independent high-rate waveform validation

entries.verified_subset: Three nonnegative loss terms (constant, wavenumber-squared, frequency-squared) on the uniform simply supported midpoint grid: per-step dissipation >= 0, no unforced energy gain, forced and unforced energy ledger closed to roundoff, zero-loss limit, amplification-root oracle versus simulated decay, overdamped classification, analytic modal reference cross-check with second-order convergence on a resolved 3-mode band, rejection of wrong loss laws, and 13 injected defects killed
entries.remaining_gap: Measured string loss, loss separated from bridge leakage, nonuniform or position-dependent loss, loss with moving supports or contacts, passive internal-variable extensions beyond three terms, other boundary conditions, isolated spatial and temporal orders, and any real or independent-solver decay data

entries.verified_subset: Monolithic two-mass spring midpoint energy, momentum, analytic relative mode and zero coupling
entries.remaining_gap: Actual string/body coupled partial differential system, moving bridge and calibrated complex FRFs

entries.verified_subset: Co-located equal/opposite two-mass spring forces with summed midpoint power and stored spring energy
entries.remaining_gap: Independent string and body solvers, 3D port transforms, multirate sample matching and deliberately delayed feedback negative tests

entries.verified_subset: Mandatory acquisition channel/unit schema, raw file SHA-256, traversal rejection and missing consent/calibration references
entries.remaining_gap: Real calibrated measurement, uncertainty propagation, contradictory orthotropic tensors and human rights review

entries.verified_subset: Mandatory 13 qualification gates and fail-closed outcome/evidence metadata, including PNG, validator exit and deadline fields
entries.remaining_gap: Actual completed matrix across three OS, released plugin identity, real host/DAW, real-time hardware traces and blind study

entries.verified_subset: Synthetic four-string prototype: one-sided power-law nail channel driven by a prescribed surface trajectory; per-step discrete-gradient energy ledger (modal + interaction potential - nail work + damping/release dissipation) closes to roundoff, release dissipation is nonnegative and no energy is created after slip-off
entries.remaining_gap: Measured nail/flesh contact law, nail compliance and mass, tangential friction and stick-slip, finite contact patch, practitioner-defined strokes, dynamically driven (not prescribed) finger motion and any comparison with recorded plucks

entries.verified_subset: Slip-off time and string state at release for a slow synthetic stroke compared across sample rates and against the quasi-static point-stiffness oracle F_release*x*(L-x)/(T*L) for the ideal string at the contact point
entries.remaining_gap: High-speed video or force-sensor release data, friction-governed release, rate dependence beyond the tested synthetic speeds, modal-truncation error budget for sharp contacts and convergence of the full radiated pressure

entries.verified_subset: Finger pad slid along an energized synthetic string across tied-fret obstacles with the energy ledger enabled: sliding work booked as external actuator work, fret/finger contact and stick-spring switching energy reported, ledger residual at roundoff and string energy not erased
entries.remaining_gap: Measured fret geometry and gut fret compliance, finger flesh friction and rolling, lateral string bending (pitch bends), nonlinear tension rise from pressing, multi-finger ornaments and practitioner-reviewed slide technique

entries.verified_subset: Releasing a pressed synthetic finger returns the open-string pitch while the nut-side and bridge afterlength segments remain part of the same persistent modal state; the transition is booked in the ledger instead of zeroing modes
entries.remaining_gap: Measured afterlength damping and tail-anchor termination, partial or rolling releases, finger damping identification, pull-off ornaments and comparison with recorded setar releases on a reference specimen

entries.verified_subset: Identical synthetic gesture event streams replayed on separate prepared instances and after reset() produce bitwise identical float output and diagnostics in the same build
entries.remaining_gap: Cross-platform/compiler bit identity, measured gesture trajectories, random-seeded excitations, withheld stroke angles, contact-work comparison across block partitions under host-driven timing and a strike-speed envelope study

entries.verified_subset: Plucking one synthetic string excites an undriven string only through the shared modal body and bridge springs; the undriven string acquires mechanical energy and the shared-body ledger stays closed
entries.remaining_gap: Measured multi-port bridge mobility, detuning sweeps with predicted beating direction, cavity and lateral body paths verified separately, comparison with measured sympathetic response of a reference specimen

entries.verified_subset: With all body bridge participation set to zero (or no body modes) the undriven synthetic strings stay identically zero while the driven string still sounds, so no hidden mixing path transfers motion between strings
entries.remaining_gap: Limits of infinite body mass and extreme impedance, rigid-bridge versus compliant-bridge frequency shifts against an independent coupled solver, and order-independence of subsystem evaluation

entries.verified_subset: Re-striking a ringing synthetic string continues its existing modal state: no note event allocates or resets a string, and the pre-stroke motion is still present after the second stroke
entries.remaining_gap: Host note-event mapping under a qualified plugin, unstruck-string symmetry across all four strings, ornaments with overlapping contacts and practitioner-reviewed playing sequences

entries.verified_subset: The response to a second synthetic nail stroke differs from the same stroke on a string at rest, demonstrating that the contact interaction depends on prior string motion rather than replaying a fixed excitation
entries.remaining_gap: Quantified restrike-dependence against a measured instrument, nail damping of a ringing string, rapid tremolo (riz) contact overlap and perceptual relevance of the difference

entries.verified_subset: Replaced global operator new/delete count zero allocations and deallocations inside Instrument::process() after prepare() for a synthetic gesture stream exercising nail, finger and fret contacts
entries.remaining_gap: Locks and system calls, platform allocator hooks on Windows/macOS, the JUCE adapter boundary, asset replacement, telemetry handoff, measured callback timing distributions on representative hardware

entries.verified_subset: Configured capacities are enforced: interaction channels, Newton iterations and events per block never exceed ProcessSpec limits and overflow is reported through ProcessSummary counters instead of unbounded work
entries.remaining_gap: Measured worst-case CPU time per block, deadline-miss statistics under load, denormal/fast-math policies, multirate paths and qualification on supported hosts and processors

entries.verified_subset: Transfer mobility computed from the synthetic plate/cavity/lateral modal BodyConfig is symmetric between bridge contacts (Y_ij = Y_ji) over a frequency grid
entries.remaining_gap: Measured multi-axis bridge mobility with calibration and uncertainty, rotational degrees of freedom, non-proportional damping and reciprocity under real boundary conditions of a setar body

entries.verified_subset: Driving-point mobility of every synthetic bridge contact has nonnegative real part over a frequency grid, consistent with nonnegative modal damping and positive modal masses
entries.remaining_gap: Measured complex mobility matrices, passivity of the full multiport matrix including cross terms, held-out FRFs and passive extrapolation beyond the retained modal band

entries.verified_subset: Synthetic orthotropic plate constants obey the reciprocity relation nu_RL = nu_LR*E_R/E_L used to build the bending stiffness matrix of the prototype soundboard
entries.remaining_gap: Measured mulberry or other specimen tensors with uncertainty, full 3D orthotropic tensors, moisture/temperature dependence and audit of published setar wood values

entries.verified_subset: The synthetic plate constitutive matrix is positive definite and an inadmissible combination (|nu_LR| >= sqrt(E_L/E_R) or nonpositive moduli) is rejected before any body mode is built
entries.remaining_gap: Positive definiteness of measured or published 3D tensors, quarantine of contradictory literature values, joint and finish stiffness and rotated grain frames

entries.verified_subset: Changing synthetic radiation weights or observation gain changes the output pressure but leaves every mechanical state, contact force and energy-ledger term unchanged (one-way observation)
entries.remaining_gap: Calibrated microphones and room, directivity against held-out angles, radiation damping derived rather than absorbed into modal damping, and acoustic feedback where it matters

entries.verified_subset: A synthetic FingerMove slide follows the requested speed with continuous pad position and finite, ledger-closed contact forces across fret positions; no state reset accompanies the control movement
entries.remaining_gap: Tension retuning transitions, peg actuator model, block-partition invariance of host-driven control trajectories and practitioner review of glissando technique

publication_rule: Never equate executable_partial with numerically_verified of an entire requirement, measured_validated, or integrated_qualified. The playable four-string prototype uses synthetic parameters only; no full setar engine has passed the complete 79-case acceptance matrix.
